angle: Movement translation, DL (clearest of five groups screened, Fig 2C): each lineman's tracked Combine 40 start laid over his own random NFL pass-rush starts (combine_frames vs game_frames_sample). The curve does not translate after size (rho 0.07 [-0.14, 0.28], n=67; no per-player similarity score above 0.18 vs pressure beyond pick). Agreement between the official 40 time and the NFL first step ('Both') explains pressure beyond pick on held-out classes and is now tested with every pick-matched pair and a hashed 2026 pre-registration.
metric_name: Speed that translates ('Both'): NFL first step (speed 0.3-0.5 s after first movement on ~20 random sampled pass rushes, alignment-adjusted, in sd after weight and EDGE share) in the top third AND official 40 time in the top half; each class's cut-offs set on the other two classes
headline_number: Pool 69 of 118 DL. Both shortlist beats the held-out pick/weight/role pressure forecast 8 of 10 vs 16 of 59 (gap 53 pts [28, 75], shuffle p 0.009); frozen after 2024 and scored on 2025 vs persistence 6 of 7 vs 6 of 16. Every pick-matched pair (same class and role, nearest pick): career 7 of 10, +2.5 pressure-rate pts [0.3, 4.6], sign p 0.17; frozen 2024->2025 4 of 7, +3.4 [0.5, 6.2], p 0.50. Continuous: NFL first step +0.8 pts per sd [0.1, 1.4] held out. 2026 test pre-registered (sha256 in frozen_rule.json): power 90% at time-forward rates, 32% at half the gap.
what_changed_from_previous: Revision of round_15/cand_3 (8.18), applying the round-15 judges' top_changes by analogy. (1) One number per claim: a single held-out forecast per player everywhere (Table 3 and Fig 1 now use the same forecast as Tables 2 and the text; asserted in code); one season-pressure figure (6.4 more than the rest); an appendix 'Estimands' paragraph labels the random-intercept 0.7 and IPW 0.9 as re-fits of the Table 1 slope and the +0.4 time-forward slope as a different estimand; 'earlier round' wording removed. (2) Hand-picked worked case replaced by every pick-matched pair (new Fig 4, bootstrap and sign test, career and frozen-2024); Johnson vs Jean-Baptiste kept only as an illustration and shown to be his actual career twin. (3) Pre-registered 2026 test: rule, list, act-on names and test hashed (full sha256) into frozen_rule.json with date, data cut and power. (4) 2026 list usability: role, availability flag (25%+ games missed), the 2024 call's 2025 hit/miss by name, a pre-specified act-on rule; the writeup leads with three names (extend Young, Diaby; expand Chop Robinson with a midseason re-score). (5) New 'Why pass rushers, why now' paragraph; one-sentence metric definition. (6) Viz: Fig 1 league IQR band plus median path; Fig 3 legend outside the data area; Fig 2B larger tick labels; Fig 2C low-reliability groups greyed.
open_risks: The two-signal form was chosen after seeing all three classes; only the cut-offs are held out. 2026 is the first blind test, and power at half the observed gap is only 32%
Matched-pair sign tests are not significant (career p 0.17, frozen p 0.50); the pair evidence rests on the size of wins, not their count; twins can repeat (8 distinct of 10 career)

Chop Robinson is an act-on name but missed his 2025 persistence check; the act-on rule (300+ rushes, +1 pt over forecast, <25% games missed) was set in this round, Byron Murphy sits just under the +1 pt line
Day-3 evidence is thin: 3 shortlisted day-3 rushers (2 of 3 hit, shuffle p 0.22)
Power calculation assumes all 11 list members and 59 others log 100+ 2026 rushes; games missed counts games without a recorded snap, not injury reports
